recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13391 unless PA later decides to change the Extension Pack artifact or supersede the extension with a first-class core element.
issue_request: FHIR-13391 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by Patient Administration. It requested a way for Location to identify a geographic area rather than only a point, and the accepted resolution was a standard extension named location-boundary-geojson with cardinality 0..1 and value Attachment carrying GeoJSON inline in Attachment.data or externally in Attachment.url with contentType application/geo+json.
initial_application: Historical GF#13391 commits pre-applied the Location boundary extension and then adjusted it from string to Attachment with application/geo+json data/url guidance. Later refactors removed the old core extension spreadsheet representation, and FHIR-19725 added the current Location notes, Washington DC metro example, contains SearchParameter, and Location.position comment that expose the extension from active core Location pages.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Location, so the inspected source/location files are in build scope. The canonical extension definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than core, where StructureDefinition-location-boundary-geojson constrains value[x] to Attachment on Location and preserves the GeoJSON data/url guidance. Later PA issue FHIR-47304 rejected adding a first-class core GeoJSON element because the extension and example already cover the use case; FHIR-28346 kept GeoJSON volumes out of scope, and FHIR-10234 is an earlier duplicate/background request.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current core source points Location.position users to location-boundary-geojson, documents boundary/contains searching, defines the location-contains SearchParameter, and includes a Washington DC metro Location example using valueAttachment with contentType application/geo+json. The authoritative extension artifact is present in the Extension Pack, so re-adding a core extension definition or adding a core Location element would be contrary to the current source organization and later PA guidance.
